Weapons:

---

Assault: 

- All assault rifles have ADS movement speed increased from 0.38 to 0.665.

FAMAS: Penetration power increased from "medium" to "large".
SCAR-H: Penetration power increased from "medium" to "large".
TAR-21: Penetration power increased from "medium" to "large".
M16A4: Penetration power increased from "medium" to "large".
ACR: Slightly decreased rate of fire from 789 to 750.
F2000: Decreased recoil (centerspeed from 1500 to 1600, gunkick pitch max from 70 to 65).
AK-47: Penetration power increased from "medium" to "large". No longer has increased penetration like FMJ with Holographic sight.

---

SMG:

ump45: Minimum damage reduced from 35 to 30. Penetration power reduced from "large" to "medium". Mag size 32 -> 25.
mp5: Maximum damage increased from 40 to 45. Penetration power increased from "small" to "medium".
p90: Maximum damage increased from 30 to 35. No longer has 1.75 sprint duration with extended mags.
uzi: Maximum damage increased from 30 to 35.

---

LMG:

- All LMG's have ADS movement speed increased from 0.35 to 0.525.

RPD: Slightly increased recoil (centerspeed from 1700 to 1600 (grip - 2000)).
M240: With FMJ now HAS increased penetration (previously didn't).

---

Sniper:

Intervention: Decreased ADS time from 400ms to 300ms. Decreased ADS idle amount from 60 to 20. 
WA2000: With FMJ now HAS increased penetration (previously didn't).
MK14 EBR: No longer has "neck" and "upper torso" damage multiplier (previously 1.1x, now 1x).

---

Pistol:

Desert Eagle: Decreased recoil (centerspeed from 600 to 1200). Increased recoil while akimbo.
Magnum: Increased recoil while akimbo.

---

Shotgun:

SPAS-12: With FMJ now HAS increased penetration (previously didn't).

---

AutoPistol:

tmp: Increased mag capacity from 15 to 25 (akimbo: 25 to 40). Increased starting ammo capacity from 45 to 75 (akimbo: 45 to 80).
g18: Increased recoil while akimbo (same as pp2000 and tmp).
M93R: Increased recoil while akimbo.
---
Launchers:

AT4: Decreased maximum damage from 155 to 110. Increased Starting ammo from 1 to 2. Decreased minimum damage from 55 to 35.
thumper: Decreased maximum damage from 155 to 110.
RPG-7: Decreased maximum damage from 160 to 120. Decreased minimum damage from 60 to 40.

-----

Attachments:

Grenade launcher: Decreased damage radius from 300 units to 200. Minimum damage decreased from 25 to 20.

---

Equipment:

Stun: Reduced throw speed (same as flash now).
Semtex: Reduced maximum damage from 200 to 150.
Claymore: Reduced maximum damage from 200 to 150.

---
